title: Similar structures under Menkaure (2+2) and the Sphinx (one)
summary: Filippo Biondi tells of Similar structures under Menkaure (2+2) and the Sphinx (one), about 2025 at Egypt (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Menkaure pyramid and Sphinx, Giza, Egypt

tellings.quote: that we found in Khafre we found the same thing also in Menkaure and also under the Sphinx.

plain: A scientist named Filippo Biondi, who says he used radar scans to look beneath the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 he found structures under the pyramid of Khafre. He says he found the same kind of thing under the pyramid of Menkaure, two pairs of them, and one under the Sphinx, the great carved lion statue nearby. If true, it would mean there is a hidden, planned system underground across the whole site.
